findings.claim: The public GET /groups/:name/members endpoint now defaults to limit=50 for every group, but the public route and template have no pagination controls, so members after the 50th cannot be reached.

In the group member row itemView, {{#unless automatic}} resolves against the member (Discourse.User) rather than the group, so `automatic` is undefined and the remove link is shown for automatic groups.
The 'cannot remove members from automatic groups' controller spec sends xhr :put to remove_member, but the route is DELETE; it passes only because controller specs skip routing.
The limit and offset params on the members endpoint are not validated or clamped: negative values reach SQL and cause errors, and limit has no upper cap.
The usernames input is not cleared after an add operation.

coverage: pooled issues; severity and verdict are placeholders
